description: A home-health intake supervisor must assign the agency's only next-day skilled-nursing start-of-care visit between two hospital referrals and finalize the alternate follow-up for the patient who does not receive it, with input from a diabetes educator and a primary-care transition coordinator.

shared_context.S1: The agency has one next-day skilled-nursing start-of-care visit available, and both Patient A and Patient B are being referred for home-health services after hospital discharge.
shared_context.S2: Marisol makes the final assignment of the visit and records the follow-up plan for the other patient.
shared_context.S3: The visit can be scheduled for either 09:00 or 13:00 tomorrow.
shared_context.S4: The agency's routine intake process requires the supervisor to check with the diabetes educator and the primary-care transition coordinator before assigning the visit.

PF1.text: Patient A is leaving with a new insulin regimen and has not yet demonstrated self-administration; the discharge team requires a 90-minute diabetes-teaching start-of-care visit tomorrow, and the 09:00 slot is the only slot long enough for that visit.

PF2.text: Patient B's spouse completed medication and glucose-monitoring teach-back today, and Patient B already has a primary-care nurse check-in booked for Monday at 09:00; the spouse agreed to use that interim plan until home-health capacity is available.

acceptance_conditions: The next-day skilled-nursing visit must be assigned to Patient A.
The visit must be scheduled for 09:00 tomorrow.
The visit duration must be exactly 90 minutes.
Patient B's alternate follow-up must be recorded as a primary-care nurse check-in on Monday at 09:00.
A commitment must document confirmation of Patient B's spouse's interim plan.

content_checks.C4: ('Monday' in decisions['patient_b_follow_up'] and '09:00' in decisions['patient_b_follow_up'] and ('primary-care' in decisions['patient_b_follow_up'] or 'PCP' in decisions['patient_b_follow_up'] or 'nurse check-in' in decisions['patient_b_follow_up'])) or any('Monday' in c['detail'] and '09:00' in c['detail'] and ('primary-care' in c['detail'] or 'PCP' in c['detail'] or 'nurse check-in' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C5: ('spouse' in decisions['patient_b_follow_up'] and ('teach-back' in decisions['patient_b_follow_up'] or 'agreed' in decisions['patient_b_follow_up'] or 'interim plan' in decisions['patient_b_follow_up'])) or any('spouse' in c['detail'] and ('teach-back' in c['detail'] or 'agreed' in c['detail'] or 'interim plan' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: Patient A's new insulin regimen and required 90-minute teaching visit change the assignment to Patient A, the time to 09:00, and the duration to exactly 90 minutes.
Patient B's completed caregiver training and booked Monday 09:00 primary-care check-in change the alternate plan to that exact appointment and require confirmation of the spouse's interim agreement.
